kanagawa-nights.title: v4.2.1 Patch Notes - Neon Tide
kanagawa-nights.body: Night market stalls now restock on a 20 minute timer. Fixed the vending machine that ate your yen and gave nothing back. Shika herds no longer path through the expressway.

kanagawa-nights.title: Lantern Run - double drops all weekend
kanagawa-nights.body: Clear any ward event between Friday 18:00 and Monday 06:00 JST for doubled currency and a Lantern Frog companion at 20 clears.

kanagawa-nights.title: Scheduled maintenance - Sept 5, 04:00 JST
kanagawa-nights.body: All channels offline for roughly two hours while we move the market shard. Compensation mailed on return.

kanagawa-nights.title: Takoyaki cart cosmetic returns to the shop
kanagawa-nights.body: Back by request for two weeks only, alongside the retro TV housing decoration.

kanagawa-nights.title: Action taken against 1,204 accounts
kanagawa-nights.body: Routine sweep for automation in the delivery loop. Appeals through the support portal.

kanagawa-nights.title: v4.2.0 - the rain rework
kanagawa-nights.body: Weather now drives reflections on every street surface, and puddles persist for ten minutes after a storm.

shibuya-drift.title: Midnight Circuit ranked season 7 is live
shibuya-drift.body: New ward rotation, and the scooter class is finally legal in ranked. Placement runs open for ten days.

shibuya-drift.title: v2.8.0 - handling pass on the taxi class
shibuya-drift.body: Weight transfer reworked, brake bias exposed in tuning, and the wall-ride exploit at Dogenzaka is gone.

shibuya-drift.title: Ghost data migration
shibuya-drift.body: Ghosts recorded before v2.6 will stop replaying after the season rolls over. Export your best laps.

deer-trail.title: Chapter II is out now
deer-trail.body: Six hours of new trail, the old station line, and a photo mode that finally has a tripod.

deer-trail.title: Save files from the demo carry over
deer-trail.body: Drop your demo save in the Documents folder and the game will pick it up on next boot.

torii-tactics.title: Early access build 0.9.2
torii-tactics.body: Frog AI now flanks. Balance is deliberately loose while we watch the numbers, so expect weekly changes.

drone-runner.title: Global leaderboard reset
drone-runner.body: Season three boards are live. Top 100 keep their courier badge permanently.

kaiju-frog.title: Emergency maintenance in progress
kaiju-frog.body: We took the servers down after the rainy season event caused duplicate boss spawns. Back at 06:00 JST.
